reason: Integrates ClawRouters as a DSH provider and exposes chat, image generation, video generation, and structured web search through one configured API credential.

summaries.zh: 通过一个 API 密钥将 ClawRouters 的聊天、图像生成、视频生成和网页搜索能力接入 DeepSeek Harness。
summaries.en: Connects ClawRouters to DeepSeek Harness with one API key for chat, image generation, video generation, and web search.

capabilities: Sends chat, image-generation, video-generation, and web-search requests to the ClawRouters API
Reads an API credential from DSH credential storage or the CLAWROUTERS_API_KEY environment variable
Persists generated images as DSH attachments and returns provider-hosted video URLs
